source_register.notes: Identifies the Academy as a higher professional training and research centre and sole entry route to the diplomatic career.

institutional_core.mission: Provide professional formation for candidates to Peru's Diplomatic Service and continuous training and development for serving diplomatic personnel.
institutional_core.governance: A professional training centre of Peru's Ministry of Foreign Affairs, dependent on the Vice Minister of Foreign Affairs and governed by its own regulations.
institutional_core.programme_model: Initial professional formation linked to admission into the Diplomatic Service plus continuous training and professional development.
institutional_core.learning_model: Structured professional diplomatic formation tied directly to career entry and continued service development.
institutional_core.assessment_model: Admission to the Academy and progression into the Diplomatic Service are formally regulated; this first-pass dossier does not yet map the full internal assessment system.
institutional_core.research_model: The Ministry identifies the Academy as a higher professional training and research centre.
institutional_core.professional_practice_model: The Academy is the sole entry route to the Diplomatic Service and trains serving members of that service.
institutional_core.credential_model: The Academy's institutional role is linked to entry into the Diplomatic Service; detailed credential issuance/verification requires deeper source review.
institutional_core.digital_transparency_model: Official government pages expose mandate, governance relationship, admission-related information and institutional role.
distinctive_practices: sole institutional entry route to the national Diplomatic Service
combined initial formation and continuing professional development
formal ministry governance with own regulations
